documents.title: Slip opinion (January 20, 2026)
documents.metadataOutcome: Catalog identity/association matches source; no new correction required.

pages.observation: Syllabus 1: Berk v Choy, No. 24-440; argued October 6, 2025, decided January 20, 2026; Delaware affidavit requirement inapplicable in federal court.
Syllabus 2: Rules 8, 12, 56, 11 and Enabling Act; reversed/remanded.
Syllabus 3: Barrett majority, eight justices; Jackson concurs in judgment.
Majority 1: Barrett caption/date; malpractice background; holding.
Majority 2: Delaware section 6853 requirements and Berk filing history.
Majority 3: lower-court decisions and choice-of-law analysis; certiorari granted 604 U.S. 1193.
Majority 4: Rules Enabling Act and disputed question; footnote 1 starts.
Majority 5: Rule 8/12 and Twombly; footnote 1 continuation.
Majority 6: pleading requirements, affidavit evidence, Dishmon and Jones.
Majority 7: Cohen distinction; footnote 2 responds to concurrence.
Majority 8: preconditions and respondents proposed altered timing.
Majority 9: Rule 56 summary judgment; Rule 11 affidavit argument.
Majority 10: Rule 11 third-party distinction; Enabling Act validity.
Majority 11: Rule 8 validity; reversal and remand; It is so ordered.
Jackson concurrence 1: caption/date; Rules 3 and 12 disagreement with Rule 8 rationale.
Concurrence 2: Rule 3 and conflict inquiry; footnote 1 begins.
Concurrence 3: rule validity; differing framing; footnote 1 continues.
Concurrence 4: commencing versus dismissing action; statutory filing requirements.
Concurrence 5: Rule 3 filing sufficiency; footnote 2.
Concurrence 6: Cohen, Walker, Woods distinguished; footnote 3.
Concurrence 7: Woods conclusion; section II B begins Rule 8 critique.
Concurrence 8: Rule 8 regulates pleading contents; affidavit separate.
Concurrence 9: narrow pleading question; footnotes 4 and 5.
Concurrence 10: section III Rule 12; footnote 6 court-of-appeals cases.
Concurrence 11: Hall v Sorouri, dismissal and matter outside pleadings; footnote 7 starts.
Concurrence 12: sealed affidavit separate from pleading; Rule 12 conclusion; footnote 7 continues.
Concurrence 13: Rules 3/12 conclusion; concurs only in judgment. Complete PDF ends here.
